prompt: Production asset sheet for Phimond, muted Octopath Traveler HD-2D pixel art. Crisp large color clusters, 2–4 shade steps, dark hue-tinted contours, top-left warm highlights and cool shadows. Muted antique gold, parchment, patinated bronze. Pet sheets only calibrate pixel outline/color shading, NOT content. No words, no labels, no digits, no scenery, no glow/bloom, no cast shadows. Each icon isolated on genuine transparent alpha with very wide clear gaps, centered equal grid cells. Readable silhouette at32x32. Do not connect objects. EXACT order left-to-right row-by-row. Redraw original rank emblems exactly as reference1 identity, preserve tier shapes/material and number of small pips. Exactly16icons in4columns x4rows. Row1 original rank01(bronze green shield1pip),rank02(same2pips),rank03(3),rank04(4). Row2 rank05(5pips),rank11(silver blue wingedshield1bluepip),rank12(2),rank13(3). Row3 rank14(4),rank15(5),rank21(gold magenta shield1pale-purplepip),rank22(2). Row4 rank23(3),rank24(4),rank25(5),rank31(silver violet bladedwing shield1purplepip). No lettering or numerals. Keep distinct silhouettes and same opticalheight. Occupy cells from top-left regularly,no large headergap.
